questions.question: God warned people living under siege that trouble was coming. What did He tell them to do?

answers.text: Gather up their belongings from the land
Rebuild the walls around their city
Open the gates to the enemy army

questions.question: God warned that a great commotion would make the cities of Judah a desolation. Where would it come from?
In a prayer about coming disaster in Judah, how did the one praying ask the LORD to correct him?

answers.text: Only with justice and not in anger
Quickly so that it will soon be over
Privately and away from the people
